targets.name: reflection
targets.protection: Preserve fine slanted bright bands, physical reflection, and cyan surroundings. Require distinct additional gradation rather than a darker patch.

targets.name: colour-control
targets.protection: Preserve blue/pink variation, fine irregular texture and small dark marks. This textured region is not a flat-noise control.

decision: Independent complete-image plus native-target review; no quality score from clipping counts or global dimming; no sweep after no clear gain.
